response.sql:
WITH spatial_with_funding AS (
  SELECT 
    s.aream2,
    s.volm3,
    s.boxx,
    s.boxy,
    p.fundflux
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
per_funding_calcs AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN boxx IS NOT NULL AND boxx != 0 AND boxy IS NOT NULL
      THEN (boxy - boxx) / CAST(boxx AS REAL)
      ELSE NULL
    END) as avg_y_vs_x,
    SUM(CASE WHEN aream2 IS NOT NULL THEN aream2 ELSE 0 END) as total_area,
    SUM(CASE WHEN volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN volm3 ELSE 0 END) as total_vol
  FROM spatial_with_funding
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
with_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    avg_y_vs_x,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_vol > 0 THEN total_area / CAST(total_vol AS REAL)
      ELSE NULL
    END as area_vol_ratio
  FROM per_funding_calcs
),
cross_source_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_vol_ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM with_ratios
  WHERE area_vol_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  wr.fundflux,
  wr.avg_y_vs_x,
  wr.area_vol_ratio,
  wr.area_vol_ratio - csa.avg_ratio as above_average
FROM with_ratios wr, cross_source_avg csa
WHERE wr.area_vol_ratio IS NOT NULL
  AND wr.area_vol_ratio > csa.avg_ratio
ORDER BY wr.fundflux;

assumptions.assumption: When summing aream2 and volm3 across records for the ratio, null values are excluded from their respective sums independently (e.g., a record with aream2=5 and volm3=NULL contributes 5 to total_area but nothing to total_vol).

alternatives.interpretation: For the area-to-volume ratio, only include records where both aream2 and volm3 are non-null, rather than summing the non-null values independently.
